cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Helpful Culprit
cards.instruction: Hide that the problem is your fault while enthusiastically helping investigate it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll organize the vase investigation. Let's start with that open window; you can tell me which way the wind was blowing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I saw your elbow knock it off the table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent, a witness. You describe the elbow movement and I'll reconstruct the space. We won't need you to guess about the wind.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your elbow only moved because you reached for the biscuits.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you place the biscuit tin. I'll stand wherever you say and measure the gap. We should find out who left such a narrow route to the food.

reason: Make B explicitly establish A elbow and reaching as cause; A yields reconstruction placement to B while enthusiastically moving blame toward layout rather than admitting fault.
